calls.summary:
# Notifications and Approvals
Date: 2026-10-08 | Duration: 48m

## Summary
The team agreed to replace the confusing JSON-based review experience with a human-friendly system that supports assigning reviews to users or teams, sending notifications, tracking ownership, and distinguishing completed work from reviews needing attention. The redesign includes reminders, priority flags, robot-versus-human attribution, and backend agent-token support. Reviewers should be able to approve, deny, or request changes in a fast sequential flow. Change visualization will use color-coded diffs, collapsible context, human-readable condition components, and precise highlighting of modified rules or targeting. Archetype-based impact simulation was proposed as a future enhancement. The interface will unify review and publish experiences, integrate contextual comments, reduce navigation clutter through collapsible menus, improve mobile layouts, and use floating or pop-over actions. Feature and experiment review designs will be aligned through iterative releases, customer feedback, follow-up meetings, and ongoing collaboration.

## Keywords
Review System, Notifications, UI Design, Change Requests, Assignments, Diff View

## Action Items

**Guy Langford-lee**
Send updated design mockups incorporating discussed improvements to the team to enable faster iteration (36:01)
Set up a follow-up meeting (part two) once the designs mature, share details in the team channel, and invite interested members for broader participation and visibility (37:51)

**Gabe Melean**
Continue parallel work on experiment review design aligned with feature approval design, share insights with the team, and optionally include Andy White in meetings for additional context (36:15)

**Unassigned**
Prioritize redesign of the main navigation sidebar to reduce its real estate usage and improve user experience, coordinating with the team already working on this (22:43)
